name: Terrace
author: Anton Dresden & Buzz Siler (1992)
description: The terraced board: squares sit at eight different heights, rising in L-shaped steps from the two lowest corners to the two highest. Pieces come in four sizes and capture only by moving diagonally DOWN onto a piece of the same size or smaller — including, famously, one of your own. Walk your marked 'T' to the lowest square across the board, or capture your opponent's.
